report.title: Plan to identify 10 Indian B2B potential customers for OneClarity
report.summary: I planned and delivered an initial researched draft of 10 Indian engineering-led potential customers for OneClarity and saved the results to a CSV. Ten potential leads were identified, but only partial verification was possible for leadership emails and some company details due to Google rate-limiting (HTTP 429). The CSV includes company websites, estimated sizes (unverified), rationale for fit, and drafted personalised outreach messages for each; the file oneclarity_india_leads.csv has been saved.

Share the updated oneclarity_india_leads.csv and outreach templates with the team.
